First 3-4 ta class mone hbe sir onk cool curve korbe, quiz nibe kom nicee. Then quiz-1 diye kanna korben. Then mid diye vabben more kn jai na. Then every class er last e kanna korben. Still jodi apni every lecture follow kore note nite paren. Onnnk onnk onnk concentrate kore lecture bujhen, sir er boi ta theke poren, ager jei class note sir dibe oigula poren. Then A/A- pete paren. But MDY apnake eita at least bujhaye dbe je electrical engineering kn one of the hardest engineering. Peace

This course is very theoretical, so the key is really understanding the concepts and the physics behind them. The questions aren’t usually direct, but once you understand what he’s actually asking, they become much easier to answer. His classes can be hard to follow for most students, so taking detailed notes,writing down everything he puts on the board helps a lot. Going through class notes from previous semesters is also useful. What worked best for me though, was carefully reading his book, since his lectures closely follow it. Also he usually hints at the type of questions to expect before the midterm and final, so paying attention to that and practicing accordingly makes a big difference
